name: plan_kms_key
description: Registers an existing, customer-managed KMS key against a duploai_plan, making it selectable by every resource group in the environments that plan is attached to. Resources such as duploai_node_group, duploai_s3_bucket and duploai_rds_instance reference it through their own kms_key_id attribute; the backend resolves that value against the resource group's own registry first, then the plan-level registry. Register a key here rather than per resource group when one key should serve a whole environment. Registration does not grant any permissions on the key — its own key policy must already trust the account and role that will use it.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns the parent plan.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: ID of the duploai_plan to register this key against. The plan must belong to workspace_id.

attributes.name: key_name
attributes.description: Friendly label for this registration. Required by the API, and must be unique within the plan (compared case-insensitively).

attributes.name: key_id
attributes.description: Raw AWS KMS key ID, e.g. 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab. Required by the API even though it also appears inside key_arn, and must be unique within the plan. Consuming resources may pass either this or key_arn as their kms_key_id.
attributes.patternDescription: must be a KMS key id: a 36-character UUID such as 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab, or a multi-region key id such as mrk-1234abcd12ab34cd56ef1234567890ab. Pass the bare id here — the full ARN goes in key_arn

attributes.name: key_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the existing customer-managed KMS key, e.g. arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab. Required, and must be unique within the plan. Prefer wiring this value into a consuming resource's kms_key_id: it is unambiguous across accounts and regions, and it is what the backend stores and hands to the cloud.
attributes.patternDescription: must be a KMS key ARN of the form arn:aws:kms:<region>:<12-digit-account>:key/<key-id>, e.g. arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab. The aws-us-gov partition is accepted; an alias ARN (:alias/...) is not, because the registry matches on the key's own id and ARN

attributes.name: key_entry_id
attributes.description: This registration's own backend record ID, distinct from key_id (the AWS KMS key's ID). The API deletes a registration by this value.
